world_gdp.note: 2024 is the last fully finalized year in the World Bank series (a 2025 figure, ~$118.35T, also exists in the same series but is a preliminary/near-final estimate, not yet closed out).

valuation_source.note: Sum of official (central-bank) reserve tonnes across all listed countries, at current spot price. Does not include annual mine production value -- that's a flow, not a held asset. Per-country detail and sourcing lives on the Gold page itself.

133 curated global trade routes/chokepoints -- no single standard published $ figure exists for 'the value of the world's supply chain' as a whole, and individual paths carry qualitative 'estimated global share' text, not consistent $ figures. Marked unavailable rather than estimated. A future pass could derive a real, cited $ value per path from trade-volume data where a citable figure exists.

valuation_source.as_of: undated (FAO World Banana Forum, standing characterization -- not a dated annual statistic)

sources.title: FAO World Banana Forum -- "Bananas are the world's most exported fresh fruit (US$10bn/year)"
FAO -- Banana Market Review 2024 (19.65 million tonnes exported, 2024; volumes and per-country unit prices only, no aggregate global $ figure published)

valuation_source.note: This is a real, FAO-sourced figure, but an approximate/undated order-of-magnitude characterization, not a precise year-stamped statistic -- FAO's own Banana Market Review series publishes export volumes (19.65 million tonnes in 2024) and per-country per-tonne unit prices, but no aggregate global export-value total in USD. Presented with that caveat rather than as false precision. (Global production, for context only, not used in this valuation: ~135.1 million tonnes in 2022 per FAOSTAT via Wikipedia -- FAOSTAT itself was unreachable, HTTP 521, during research.)
